description: This file contains the PHP class 'OrderStatus' which defines methods for managing order status entities within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class includes functions for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving order statuses and their descriptions from the database.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Represents the model for handling order status data within the OpenCart admin localisation module.

methods.name: addOrderStatus
methods.description: Inserts a new order status into the database, handling multiple languages and caching.

methods.name: editOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing order status and its descriptions, then clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatus
methods.description: Deletes a specific order status by its ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all order status descriptions for a specific language ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific order status based on its ID and current language.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of order statuses filtered and sorted according to provided criteria, with caching.

methods.name: getTotalOrderStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of order statuses for the current language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific order status ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions of order statuses for a specific language ID.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific order status in a given language.
